scope: Full static review of ordinary maintenance panel and shared review/inspection helpers; no real deletion performed
findings: Stalled maintenance request had no bound; extracted existing request helper and added 20-second abort with uncertain-outcome message.
review_notes: Plan creation, quarantine, recovery and permanent deletion remain distinct; selection resets authorization and typed confirmation.
Purge requires exact PURGE input plus actor/reason/review; runtime revalidation remains authoritative.
Uncertain mutation clears selection and blocks new writes until saved history is loaded; no automatic retry.
Execution observation binds selected identity, known verdict and PASS-only execution_verified; saved recorded status is separate.
Timeout releases UI via existing catch/finally, preserves unresolved mutation state and never retries or claims server cancellation.

regression.red: No abort signal after 20001ms; expected aborted=true failed
regression.green: 5 tests across 3 files passed; typecheck/build passed on Node25.8.2

additional_cases: Successful response clears deadline without later abort
Server refusal preserves error and clears deadline
